narration.text: [whispers] We set the ball down on the third floor. Nobody touched it. [long pause] [softly] Waverly Hills Sanatorium. Louisville, Kentucky. A hospital for tuberculosis. [long pause] Before there was a cure, thousands of patients died here. [long pause] The bodies went down a tunnel under the hill, five hundred feet long, so the living wouldn't see them leave. [long pause] Ghost stories say sixty-three thousand died. The records point to far fewer. Still, thousands. [long pause] Investigators bring a ball up here. They say a little boy plays with it. They call him Timmy. [long pause] No record of him has ever been found. [long pause] [whispers] Roll it back.
